<!-- pr-reviewer: 38fb8543ab556849b31d2124ea0464c95a527dbb -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**
- Minimal: deletes the dead `MIN_LABEL_PX` (painted.rs) and repoints the comment at the theme's label floor. No `#[allow(dead_code)]`.
- Nothing else references the constant: `git grep MIN_LABEL_PX` over `crates/` on the PR head finds no hits (only older `docs/decisions` text mentions it).
- Decision file `docs/decisions/2104-min-label-px.md` present; no snapshot, changelog or process-file edits.

**Results** (locally, trial merge with upstream/main 780b0a25a; PR head is a direct child of it, so the merge is a no-op)
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 892 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. The failure, `ai_chat::safety::post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`, passed on rerun alone (1/1); it is in AI-chat code this PR does not touch, so it looks like a parallel-run flake.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The reworded comment at painted.rs:98 runs past one line; cosmetic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
